prompt_refinement.style_rules: Match the palette, brush feel, lighting, icon density, and framing discipline of the selected target's reference image. Keep the final subject and asset meaning driven by the selected batch entry, not the reference subject.
prompt_refinement.composition_rules: Use the reference only as a style guide. Keep the result in the same visual family, but make it visibly distinct at a glance by changing the silhouette, crop, object arrangement, and ornament placement. Do not mirror the reference composition or reuse its exact outline.

image.natural_prompt: Minimalist victory iconography with marble, bronze, and path-specific theme-color accents.

style_reference.notes: Each output target must provide one or more same-type DDS/PNG references. The reference controls style only; the generated content follows image.natural_prompt.

building_icon.prompt_requirements: This is a compact building icon for the Wonder Worksite. Treat the uploaded Construction Center reference as the style authority: same simple painterly brushwork, compact crop, low object count, and readable 128px silhouette. Depict a wonder construction worksite using exactly 2-3 simple shapes: one small worksite shed, one crane or hoist wheel, and one pale stone foundation block. The result should feel premium through restrained marble and bronze accents while staying as simple as the reference. Do not add extra props, workers, crowds, complex scaffolding, full scenery, a finished monument, a palace, or a narrative construction scene.

image.natural_prompt: A simple Europa Universalis V building icon in the uploaded vanilla Construction Center style. Match the reference's painterly icon language, compact crop, simple silhouette, and low element count. Show a wonder construction worksite with only three clear elements: a small worksite shed, one crane or hoist wheel, and one pale stone foundation block with restrained bronze accents. Sparse, centered, readable at 128px, premium but not ornate, no text.

victory_tree_backgrounds.tree_rules: Create a clean 16:9 game UI art asset with exactly two visual depths: a route-specific blurred, low-contrast background and one crisp foreground reward tree. The background fills the canvas but remains heavily defocused and subordinate; it may suggest place and mood but must never form a second route. The foreground tree occupies most of the canvas, enters visibly from its specified outer edge, has one continuous five-waypoint main trunk, and exactly five side branches with only the listed connections. At every main-trunk or branch waypoint reserve a quiet, unmarked circular clearance zone about 96-120 pixels wide for a future circular UI overlay. Do not render a circle, button, badge, medallion, dot, gem, endpoint marker, label, or icon in any clearance zone. Keep branch corridors clearly separated, with no crossings or accidental extra branches. No text, letters, numbers, logos, UI frame, watermark, or readable map labels.
victory_tree_backgrounds.negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, labels, UI chrome, UI buttons, circular nodes, badges, medallions, dots, gems, endpoint markers, icons placed on tree anchors, logos, watermark, framed card, busy foreground scenery, sharp detailed background, a second tree, tangled crossings, disconnected branches, extra unplanned branches, photorealistic screenshot

paths.label: Conquest Victory
paths.tree_prompt: Art direction: medieval illuminated-manuscript art, distinctly different from the other routes; crimson red, aged parchment, black iron, muted bronze, and restrained gold leaf. Background layer: an intentionally blurred frontier war map, distant stone fortress walls, and indistinct banners with no readable heraldry. Foreground layer: a crisp, severe heraldic ironwood tree whose trunk resembles a campaign road and whose branches have disciplined angular marching geometry. The root enters from the lower-left border and the main trunk climbs diagonally across nearly the full frame toward the upper-right, with five widely spaced unmarked main waypoints. Exact topology, not visible labels: B1 and B2 leave M1; B1 has two additional clearance waypoints and B2 has three. B3 and B4 leave M2; B3 has two additional clearance waypoints and B4 has three. B5 leaves M3 and has two additional clearance waypoints. Fan paired branches above and below the diagonal trunk, preserve generous empty space around every waypoint, and make the ascent feel forceful, territorial, and irreversible. Do not depict soldiers, weapons, shields, or flags as clickable nodes.

paths.label: Prosperity Victory
paths.tree_prompt: Art direction: refined Art Nouveau botanical poster art, distinctly different from the other routes; leaf green, warm cream, verdigris, harvest gold, and soft terracotta accents. Background layer: a deliberately blurred prosperous valley with orchards, a granary silhouette, terraces, roofs, and a far river, all low contrast and without distinct objects near the foreground tree. Foreground layer: an elegant cultivated living tree made of graceful stems, grain-like leaves, and subtle architectural latticework, crisp against the soft backdrop. The root enters from the bottom-center border and the main trunk rises vertically through most of the canvas toward the top-center, with five widely spaced unmarked main waypoints. Exact topology, not visible labels: B1 and B2 leave M1; B1 has three additional clearance waypoints and B2 has four. B3 and B4 leave M2; B3 has two additional clearance waypoints and B4 has three. B5 leaves M3 and has three additional clearance waypoints. Keep B5 as a separate open branch with three overlay spaces, never a loop back into an earlier branch. Fan the branches rhythmically left and right like irrigation channels and fruiting boughs, with broad calm clear zones for future buttons. Do not use fruit, coins, leaves, buildings, or harvest bundles as node markers.

paths.label: Trade Victory
paths.tree_prompt: Art direction: carved maritime woodblock and antique portolan-chart print, distinctly different from the other routes; gold yellow, ink navy, weathered teal, warm paper, and small copper accents. Background layer: a heavily blurred harbor, sea lanes, distant sails, warehouses, and compass-rose-like geometry with no readable chart text or map labels. Foreground layer: one crisp braided trade-route tree made from a single gold-and-ink navigation line that becomes a strong horizontal trunk, with branch lines behaving like clean shipping corridors rather than literal roots. The root enters from the left-center border and travels across almost the entire canvas toward the right-center, with five widely spaced unmarked main waypoints. Exact topology, not visible labels: B1 leaves M1 and has two additional clearance waypoints. B2 and B3 leave M2; B2 has three additional clearance waypoints and B3 has four. B4 and B5 leave M3; each has two additional clearance waypoints. Fan branch corridors above and below the horizontal trunk without crossings, keep every waypoint calm and open, and make the route feel like expanding commercial reach. Do not draw ships, scales, coins, seals, compass points, or port symbols as clickable nodes.

paths.label: Diplomatic Victory
paths.tree_prompt: Art direction: restrained Baroque copperplate engraving with diplomatic parchment flourishes, distinctly different from the other routes; ivory white, pearl gray, ink black, muted lapis, and soft antique gold. Background layer: an intentionally blurred palace reception hall, distant embassy garden, unreadable treaty sheets, and soft candlelit architecture, all low contrast and without any foreground focal detail. Foreground layer: a crisp, graceful tree of interwoven treaty ribbons and fine engraved filigree, with a single unbroken trunk and clean, deliberate branch spacing. The root enters from the upper-left border and the trunk descends diagonally across nearly the full frame toward the lower-right, with five widely spaced unmarked main waypoints. Exact topology, not visible labels: B1 and B2 leave M1; B1 has two additional clearance waypoints and B2 has three. B3 and B4 leave M2; each has three additional clearance waypoints. B5 leaves M3 and has two additional clearance waypoints. Pair the branches in balanced opposing arcs around the diagonal, leaving generous open circular overlay zones and an atmosphere of negotiated connection rather than military force. Do not depict seals, rings, hands, doves, scroll ends, or crowns as node markers.

paths.label: Cultural Victory
paths.tree_prompt: Art direction: Chinese ink-wash painting on rice paper, distinctly different from the other routes; charcoal black ink, soft royal-purple mineral pigment, faded indigo wash, and sparse warm paper tone. Background layer: broad misty wash suggesting distant academy roofs, theatre eaves, calligraphic paper texture, and mountain-cloud atmosphere, all intentionally blurred and extremely low contrast. Foreground layer: one commanding calligraphic ink tree rendered with decisive dry-brush trunk strokes and restrained purple accents; it must remain clean enough for UI use, not a dense landscape painting. The root enters from the lower-right border and the main trunk rises diagonally across nearly the full frame toward the upper-left, with five widely spaced unmarked main waypoints. Exact topology, not visible labels: B1 and B2 leave M1; each has two additional clearance waypoints. B3 and B4 leave M2; each has two additional clearance waypoints. B5 leaves M3 and has two additional clearance waypoints. Use flowing but unambiguous brush branches with broad blank-paper breathing room around every overlay zone. Do not paint plum blossoms, masks, lyres, scroll seals, stars, or ink splatters as node markers, and do not add any Chinese characters.

paths.label: Scientific Victory
paths.tree_prompt: Art direction: clean contemporary modern technical graphic art, distinctly different from the other routes; azure blue, cyan, cool white, graphite, and a restrained brass highlight. Background layer: a deeply blurred field of observatory machinery, laboratory glass, celestial arcs, and abstract research light, with no readable diagrams or formulas. Foreground layer: a crisp modern innovation tree made of a single luminous geometric spine with precise but organic circuit-like branch corridors; it is a reward tree, not a literal user interface. The root enters from the top-center border and the main trunk travels vertically down through most of the canvas toward the bottom-center, with five widely spaced unmarked main waypoints. Exact topology, not visible labels: B1 and B2 leave M1; B1 has two additional clearance waypoints and B2 has three. B3 and B4 leave M2; each has two additional clearance waypoints. B5 leaves M3 and has two additional clearance waypoints. Fan branches alternately left and right with large clean negative-space circles around all waypoints, no crossings, and a feeling of measured discovery progressing downward. Do not draw atoms, astrolabes, lenses, constellations, circuit pads, data dots, charts, or glowing rings as node markers.
